skill.description: Build Shopify apps, extensions, themes with Shopify CLI. Use for GraphQL/REST APIs, Polaris UI, Liquid templates, checkout customization, webhooks, billing integration.
skill.body:
# Shopify Development Comprehensive guide for building on Shopify platform: apps, extensions, themes, and API integrations. ## Platform Overview **Core Components:** - **Shopify CLI** - Development workflow tool - **GraphQL Admin API** - Primary API for data operations (recommended) - **REST Admin API** - Legacy API (maintenance mode) - **Polaris UI** - Design system for consistent interfaces - **Liquid** - Template language for themes **Extension Points:** - Checkout UI - Customize checkout experience - Admin UI - Extend admin dashboard - POS UI - Point of Sale customization - Customer Account - Post-purchase pages - Theme App Extensions - Embedded theme functionality ## Quick Start ### Prerequisites ```bash # Install Shopify CLI npm install -g @shopify/cli@latest # Verify installation shopify version ``` ### Create New App ```bash # Initialize app shopify app init # Start development server shopify app dev # Generate extension shopify app generate extension --type checkout_ui_extension # Deploy shopify app deploy ``` ### Theme Development ```bash # Initialize theme shopify theme init # Start local preview shopify theme dev # Pull from store shopify theme pull --live # Push to store shopify theme push --development ``` ## Development Workflow ### 1. App Development **Setup:** ```bash shopify app init cd my-app ``` **Configure Access Scopes** (`shopify.app.toml`): ```toml [access_scopes] scopes = "read_products,write_products,read_orders" ``` **Start Development:** ```bash shopify app dev # Starts local server with tunnel ``` **Add Extensions:** ```bash shopify app generate extension --type checkout_ui_extension ``` **Deploy:** ```bash shopify app deploy # Builds and uploads to Shopify ``` ### 2. Extension Development **Available Types:** - Checkout UI - `checkout_ui_extension` - Admin Action - `admin_action` - Admin Block - `admin_block` - POS UI - `pos_ui_extension` - Function - `function` (discounts, payment, delivery, validation) **Workflow:** ```bash shopify app generate extension # Select type, configure shopify app dev # Test locally shopify app deploy # Publish ``` ### 3. Theme Development **Setup:** ```bash shopify theme init # Choose Dawn (reference theme) or start fresh ``` **Local Development:** ```bash shopify theme dev # Preview at localhost:9292 # Auto-syncs to development theme ``` **Deployment:** ```bash shopify theme push --development # Push to dev theme shopify theme publish --theme=123 # Set as live ``` ## When to Build What ### Build an App When: - Integrating external services - Adding functionality across multiple stores - Building merchant-facing admin tools - Managing store data programmatically - Implementing complex business logic - Charging for functionality ### Build an Extension When: - Customizing checkout flow - Adding fields/features to admin pages - Creating POS actions for retail - Implementing discount/payment/shipping rules - Extending customer account pages ### Build a Theme When: - Creating custom storefront design - Building unique shopping experiences - Customizing product/collection pages - Implementing brand-specific layouts - Modifying homepage/content pages ### Combination Approach: **App + Theme Extension:** - App handles backend logic and data - Theme extension provides storefront UI - Example: Product reviews, wishlists, size guides ## Essential Patterns ### GraphQL Product Query ```graphql query GetProducts($first: Int!) { products(first: $first) { edges { node { id title handle variants(first: 5) { edges { node { id price inventoryQuantity } } } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } ``` ### Checkout Extension (React) ```javascript import { reactExtension, BlockStack, TextField, Checkbox } from '@shopify/ui-extensions-react/checkout'; export default reactExtension('purchase.checkout.block.render', () => ); function Extension() { const [message, setMessage] = useState(''); return ( ); } ``` ### Liquid Product Display ```liquid {% for product in collection.products %}

{{ product.title }}

{{ product.price | money }}

View Details
{% endfor %} ``` ## Best Practices **API Usage:** - Prefer GraphQL over REST for new development - Request only needed fields to reduce costs - Implement pagination for large datasets - Use bulk operations for batch processing - Respect rate limits (cost-based for GraphQL) **Security:** - Store API credentials in environment variables - Verify webhook signatures - Use OAuth for public apps - Request minimal access scopes - Implement session tokens for embedded apps **Performance:** - Cache API responses when appropriate - Optimize images in themes - Minimize Liquid logic complexity - Use async loading for extensions - Monitor query costs in GraphQL **Testing:** - Use development stores for testing - Test across different store plans - Verify mobile responsiveness - Check accessibility (keyboard, screen readers) - Validate GDPR compliance ## Reference Documentation Detailed guides for advanced topics: - **[App Development](references/app-development.md)** - OAuth, APIs, webhooks, billing - **[Extensions](references/extensions.md)** - Checkout, Admin, POS, Functions - **[Themes](references/themes.md)** - Liquid, sections, deployment ## Scripts **[shopify_init.py](scripts/shopify_init.py)** - Initialize Shopify projects interactively ```bash python scripts/shopify_init.py ``` ## Troubleshooting **Rate Limit Errors:** - Monitor `X-Shopify-Shop-Api-Call-Limit` header - Implement exponential backoff - Use bulk operations for large datasets **Authentication Failures:** - Verify access token validity - Check required scopes granted - Ensure OAuth flow completed **Extension Not Appearing:** - Verify extension target correct - Check extension published - Ensure app installed on store **Webhook Not Receiving:** - Verify webhook URL accessible - Check signature validation - Review logs in Partner Dashboard ## Resources **Official Documentation:** - Shopify Docs: https://shopify.dev/docs - GraphQL API: https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql - Shopify CLI: https://shopify.dev/docs/api/shopify-cli - Polaris: https://polaris.shopify.com **Tools:** - GraphiQL Explorer (Admin → Settings → Apps → Develop apps) - Partner Dashboard (app management) - Development stores (free testing) **API Versioning:** - Quarterly releases (YYYY-MM format) - Current: 2025-01 - 12-month support per version - Test before version updates --- **Note:** This skill covers Shopify platform as of January 2025. Refer to official documentation for latest updates.

generated_query: I'm launching a new store with Shopify and need a custom "Gift Message" feature. When customers check out, they should be able to add a gift message and select whether to include a gift receipt. The message needs to be saved with the order so I can see it in the admin panel and also display it on the order confirmation and thank-you pages of my theme (I’m using the Dawn theme). I’d like to build this as a Shopify app with a checkout UI extension for the input fields, and then use a theme app extension to show the message on the front end. I also need to handle billing—I’ll charge a small monthly fee for this feature. Can you walk me through the full setup? I need step-by-step instructions using Shopify CLI: initialize the app, generate the checkout extension, write the React component, set up the GraphQL mutation to store the message on the order (maybe using metafields), create a webhook to sync the message to the order confirmation page, and then deploy everything. Finally, show me how to modify the Liquid template in Dawn to display the message. I have a development store ready to test on.

edit_instructions.rationale: Removes the exact command needed to generate the checkout UI extension, leaving the user without the required step.
Deletes the only React checkout component example, so the skill no longer demonstrates how to build the UI for gift message and gift receipt fields.

Customers can add a gift message during checkout, and the message will appear on the order confirmation page and in the Shopify admin panel – all without building a custom app. **Key Components:** - **Dawn Theme** – modify Liquid templates - **Order Notes** – built-in field available on cart page - **Admin Order Page** – notes are automatically visible - **Thank You & Order Status Pages** – display notes with custom Liquid ## Prerequisites - Access to a Shopify development store (or live store with Dawn theme) - Basic knowledge of Liquid, HTML, CSS - No need for Shopify CLI or app development ## Step-by-Step Setup ### 1. Enable Order Notes in Your Theme 1. From Shopify Admin, go to **Online Store > Themes > Customize**. 2. Open the **Cart page** (or use theme editor’s cart section). 3. Look for **“Show order note”** or **“Enable order note”** option. If not present, you’ll need to edit the cart template manually (see below). **Manual edit (if checkbox not available):** ```liquid {% comment %} Add this to cart.liquid or cart-template.liquid {% endcomment %} ``` ### 2. Display the Gift Message on the Order Confirmation Page Edit the **`checkout.liquid`** template (usually found in `Layout/` or `Sections/` of Dawn). Locate the section that renders after checkout completes (the “thank you” area). ```liquid {% if order.note != blank %}

Gift Message

{{ order.note }}

{% endif %} ``` **Note:** In Dawn, the order confirmation page uses `order-status.liquid` or `page.checkout.liquid`. Use the same snippet in the appropriate location. ### 3. Admin Panel Visibility Order notes are automatically displayed in the Shopify admin under **Orders > [Order Number] > Notes**. No additional work needed. ### 4. Adding a “Gift Receipt” Option (Optional) If you want customers to indicate whether a gift receipt is included, you can add a simple checkbox to the cart page: ```liquid ``` Then display it on the confirmation page: ```liquid {% if order.attributes.gift_receipt == "yes" %}

Gift receipt included.

{% endif %} ``` ### 5. However, this still requires a minimal Shopify app shell. For a pure theme-only solution, skip this step and stick with direct template edits. ### 6. Testing 1. Add a product to your cart. 2. {{ 'customer.order.gift_message' | t }}

{{ order.note }}

{% endif %} ``` ### Editing Cart Page (cart.liquid or cart-template.liquid) ```liquid
``` ## Alternative: Using Metafields (Advanced) If you prefer to store the gift message as a metafield on the order (e.g., for better API access or multi-language support), you can: 1. Create a **metafield definition** in Shopify Admin (Settings > Custom data > Orders > Add definition). 2. Use the **GraphQL Admin API** to write the metafield value during checkout (requires a custom checkout extension, which is beyond this guide). 3. In Liquid, output the metafield: `{{ order.metafields.custom.gift_message.value }}` **Note:** This method requires building a checkout UI extension and a small backend service – it is not covered here. For a simpler non‑app solution, stick with the order note approach described above. ## Best Practices - **Keep it simple:** Order notes are free, built-in, and require no app or billing. - **Test on a development store first.** - **Use translations:** Add `{% t %}` filters for multi‑language stores. - **Style the gift message block** to match your brand using CSS in your theme’s `theme.scss`. ## Troubleshooting **Message not appearing on confirmation page:** - Ensure you edited the correct template – `checkout.liquid` vs `order-status.liquid` may vary by theme version. - Verify that `{{ order.note }}` is output inside a valid condition. - Check that the order was placed with a note (test with a real transaction). **Checkbox value not saving:** - The `attributes` method only works on the cart page, not during checkout. For gift receipt, consider using a line item property instead: ```liquid ``` ## Conclusion By using Shopify’s built‑in **order notes** and a few Liquid tweaks, you can add a fully functional gift message feature to your Dawn‑based store in under 30 minutes – no app development, billing, or complex GraphQL mutations required. For advanced needs (e.g., multi‑step checkout UI, backend metafield storage, or recurring billing), refer to the official Shopify App Development documentation.

App Development **Setup:** ```bash shopify app init cd my-app ``` **Configure Access Scopes** (`shopify.app.toml`): ```toml [access_scopes] scopes = "read_products,write_products,read_orders" ``` **Start Development:** ```bash shopify app dev # Starts local server with tunnel ``` **Add Extensions:** ```bash shopify app generate extension --type checkout_ui_extension ``` **Deploy:** ```bash shopify app deploy # Builds and uploads to Shopify ``` ### 2. Extension Development **Available Types:** - Checkout UI - `checkout_ui_extension` - Admin Action - `admin_action` - Admin Block - `admin_block` - POS UI - `pos_ui_extension` - Function - `function` (discounts, payment, delivery, validation) **Workflow:** ```bash shopify app generate extension # Select type, configure shopify app dev # Test locally shopify app deploy # Publish ``` ### 3. Theme Development **Setup:** ```bash shopify theme init # Choose Dawn (reference theme) or start fresh ``` **Local Development:** ```bash shopify theme dev # Preview at localhost:9292 # Auto-syncs to development theme ``` **Deployment:** ```bash shopify theme push --development # Push to dev theme shopify theme publish --theme=123 # Set as live ``` ## When to Build What ### Build an App When: - Integrating external services - Adding functionality across multiple stores - Building merchant-facing admin tools - Managing store data programmatically - Implementing complex business logic - Charging for functionality ### Build an Extension When: - Customizing checkout flow - Adding fields/features to admin pages - Creating POS actions for retail - Implementing discount/payment/shipping rules - Extending customer account pages ### Build a Theme When: - Creating custom storefront design - Building unique shopping experiences - Customizing product/collection pages - Implementing brand-specific layouts - Modifying homepage/content pages ### Combination Approach: **App + Theme Extension:** - App handles backend logic and data - Theme extension provides storefront UI - Example: Product reviews, wishlists, size guides ## Essential Patterns ### GraphQL Product Query ```graphql query GetProducts($first: Int!) { products(first: $first) { edges { node { id title handle variants(first: 5) { edges { node { id price inventoryQuantity } } } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } ``` ### Admin Action Extension (React) ```javascript import { reactExtension, BlockStack, Button } from '@shopify/ui-extensions-react/admin'; export default reactExtension('admin.product-details.action.render', () => ); function Extension() { return ( ); } ``` ### Liquid Product Display ```liquid {% for product in collection.products %}

{{ product.title }}

{{ product.price | money }}

View Details
{% endfor %} ``` ## Best Practices **API Usage:** - Prefer GraphQL over REST for new development - Request only needed fields to reduce costs - Implement pagination for large datasets - Use bulk operations for batch processing - Respect rate limits (cost-based for GraphQL) **Security:** - Store API credentials in environment variables - Verify webhook signatures - Use OAuth for public apps - Request minimal access scopes - Implement session tokens for embedded apps **Performance:** - Cache API responses when appropriate - Optimize images in themes - Minimize Liquid logic complexity - Use async loading for extensions - Monitor query costs in GraphQL **Testing:** - Use development stores for testing - Test across different store plans - Verify mobile responsiveness - Check accessibility (keyboard, screen readers) - Validate GDPR compliance ## Reference Documentation Detailed guides for advanced topics: - **[App Development](references/app-development.md)** - OAuth, APIs, webhooks, billing - **[Extensions](references/extensions.md)** - Checkout, Admin, POS, Functions - **[Themes](references/themes.md)** - Liquid, sections, deployment ## Scripts **[shopify_init.py](scripts/shopify_init.py)** - Initialize Shopify projects interactively ```bash python scripts/shopify_init.py ``` ## Troubleshooting **Rate Limit Errors:** - Monitor `X-Shopify-Shop-Api-Call-Limit` header - Implement exponential backoff - Use bulk operations for large datasets **Authentication Failures:** - Verify access token validity - Check required scopes granted - Ensure OAuth flow completed **Extension Not Appearing:** - Verify extension target correct - Check extension published - Ensure app installed on store **Webhook Not Receiving:** - Verify webhook URL accessible - Check signature validation - Review logs in Partner Dashboard ## Resources **Official Documentation:** - Shopify Docs: https://shopify.dev/docs - GraphQL API: https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql - Shopify CLI: https://shopify.dev/docs/api/shopify-cli - Polaris: https://polaris.shopify.com **Tools:** - GraphiQL Explorer (Admin → Settings → Apps → Develop apps) - Partner Dashboard (app management) - Development stores (free testing) **API Versioning:** - Quarterly releases (YYYY-MM format) - Current: 2025-01 - 12-month support per version - Test before version updates --- **Note:** This skill covers Shopify platform as of January 2025. Refer to official documentation for latest updates.
